mechanics.receiver: Save ECX, add 4 to form the count address, and do not null-check the receiver.
mechanics.atomic_increment: Initialize ECX to 1 and execute LOCK XADD [count], ECX.
mechanics.return: Increment the old count returned in ECX and return old-count-plus-one in EAX.
mechanics.signedness: The field is observed as a signed 32-bit word; the model preserves modulo-2^32 wraparound for the returned and stored values.
mechanics.other_writes: The function has no direct calls and no writes outside the word at receiver+0x04.
